app.name: BabySmash
app.short_description: Let your baby smash buttons safely
app.long_description: A Wii port of Scott Hanselman's BabySmash. Mash any button, key or mouse button and colourful shapes, letters and numbers pop up with giggles. Supports Wiimote, Nunchuk, Classic Controller, GameCube pad, Wii U Pro Controller, Wii U GamePad, DualShock 3, USB mouse and USB keyboard. Hold HOME (or Esc) for 2 seconds to exit.
